description: This file defines the RtfDocumentRenderer class responsible for rendering a MigraDoc document into RTF format, including header, styles, fonts, colors, and document content.

classes.name: RtfDocumentRenderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering a MigraDoc document into RTF format, including header, styles, fonts, colors, and document content.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a MigraDoc document to a specified file.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overloaded method to render a document to a stream.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overloaded method to render a document to a stream with control over stream closing.

methods.name: RenderToString
methods.description: Renders a document to an RTF string.

methods.name: WriteDocument
methods.description: Internal method to write the document content into RTF format.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares font and color tables for RTF rendering.

methods.name: GetPredefinedFontNames
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined font names relevant for RTF creation.

methods.name: RenderHeader
methods.description: Renders the RTF header including font, color, style, and list tables.

methods.name: CollectTables
methods.description: Recursively collects font, color, and list information from the document object model.

methods.name: RenderFontTable
methods.description: Renders the font table in the RTF header.

methods.name: RenderColorTable
methods.description: Renders the color table in the RTF header.

methods.name: GetFontIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a font in the font table.

methods.name: GetColorIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a color in the color table.

methods.name: GetStyleIndex
methods.description: Returns the style index for a given style name.

methods.name: RenderStyles
methods.description: Renders styles into the RTF header.

methods.name: RenderListTable
methods.description: Renders list tables into the RTF header.

methods.name: RenderDocumentArea
methods.description: Renders the main document content area.

methods.name: RenderGlobalPorperties
methods.description: Renders global document properties such as margins and view settings.

methods.name: RenderDocumentFormat
methods.description: Renders document format settings like tab stops and footnotes.

methods.name: RenderSectionProperties
methods.description: Renders footnote properties for a section.

methods.name: RenderInfo
methods.description: Renders document metadata such as title, author, and keywords.
